prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A good starting point is **The House Dr** for general repairs and interior remodeling. Its Houzz profile shows a 5.0 rating from four reviews, including comments about bathroom remodels, smaller repairs, communication, and staying on budget. [See its Houzz profile](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/kitchen-and-bath-remodelers/the-house-dr-pfvwus-pf~94132317) · **(417) 437-3727**

For a larger kitchen or bathroom renovation, **GRC General Construction** is another option: BBB lists it as accredited with an A+ rating and describes kitchen, bathroom, flooring, and carpentry work. [See its BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/remodel-contractors/grc-general-construction-0734-1000049263) · **(417) 499-7424**

These are promising leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, ask for recent local references and proof of insurance, and confirm who handles permits and any subcontracted work. Ask each contractor for a written scope, payment schedule, and estimated timeline.
